title: Profile (Admin API)
description: A profile: GET /api/profiles/{profile_id}, answer of every profile write. One profile per device; profiles are created freely by the admin (max limits.max_profiles), from a suggestion, from a device or empty.

kind.description: Kind of the profile: groups profiles for “Set up new devices” (rule setup_devices) and the gallery; independent of child_protection. Only kind person may have setup_devices (other kinds resolve it to not_applicable, reason requires_profile_kind).

description.description: One sentence for the profile card.

child_protection.description: Parental controls. Not for a profile with guest devices (422 profile.guest_child_protection).

rules.description: Answers: every rule of the catalog (defaults filled in, see catalog_defaults).

fixed.description: Rules with checkbox “Fixed”: no device adjustment possible. Always contains the rules without checkbox.

user_choice.description: Rules where the person at the device decides (value = starting value).

origin.description: Suggestion the profile was copied from (information only; a later suggestion version never changes the profile).

suggestion_update.description: A newer version of the origin suggestion exists (POST /api/profiles/{profile_id}/apply-suggestion, only on request).

catalog_defaults.description: Rules the profile does not contain yet (added by a hub update); they use the catalog default until the profile is saved.

default_for.description: Device types this profile is the default profile of.

adjusted_device_count.description: Devices with at least one adjustment.

has_remote_pin.description: The profile has its own remote PIN for “settings with remote PIN”: valid for every device of the profile; a device PIN wins unless remote_pin_fixed. Never returned, only this flag.

remote_pin_fixed.description: Checkbox “Fixed” of the profile PIN: device PINs are ignored and PUT …/remote-pin answers 422 remote_pin.fixed.

scene_hints.description: Released scenes and scripts with targets this profile may not switch (docs/enforcement.md §2 step 4), computed for the profile without a device (no own area, no adjustments). Only in GET and PATCH /api/profiles/{profile_id}; empty when Home Assistant is not reachable. At most 50.

member.description: Platform ($defs/platform) -> Hub only with remote access.

guest.description: Platform ($defs/platform) -> Hub only with remote access.

hub_remote_pairing.description: Per access (member, guest) and platform: whether a device paired with this profile now would be Hub only with remote access (it would hold the read-only key because of remote access; a new device has no adjustment). Always false on tvos, android_tv, watchos and wearos. Missing on older hubs.
